# Codex Rate Monitor v0.2.0

## Fixed

- Reuse a long-lived `codex app-server` connection instead of restarting the
  process on every refresh. This fixes issue #5 (repeated process spawns and
  flickering usage windows) and makes refreshes faster and quieter.

## Added

- Read-only rate-limit reset credit tracking: the tray tooltip and overlay now
  show the remaining rate-limit reset credits available on the account.
  Nothing is ever consumed — the tool only reads the balance.
- Reduced refresh cadence while the ChatGPT desktop window is minimized, to
  save resources when usage is not visible anyway.

## Changed

- Extended the usage resync cooldown to 6 hours.
- traffic_monitor: interval deltas now respect the host filter.

## Documentation

- Condensed all three READMEs (single-image sections, traffic section, FAQ).
- New screenshots for reset credits, tray tooltip, and overlay layouts.
- Documented reset credits, the long-lived app-server, and the minimized
  refresh cadence.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.1.9...v0.2.0
